data.description:
`docs/exit-codes.md` declares itself "the single source of truth" (`:5`) covering "each public
dispatcher arm" (`:69`). It has 41 table rows against 75 real commands — independently re-derived
from `_cli/_help.known_subcommands()` union `_cli/__init__._INTERCEPTS`. The 34 omissions include
`review-plan`, `review-code`, and `verify-completion`, whose exit-11 semantics the same document
defines four lines into its own codes table.

Grounding found worse: codes **75** (`RebaseGuard`/`EXIT_RESCHEDULE`) and **78**
(`StoreIncompatibleError`) reach the process exit status via `_seam.py:419` →
`_commands/__init__.py:160` and appear nowhere in the document. 75 is the one code a CI workflow
actually branches on. Codes 3, 4, 12 and `validate`'s 0-4 severity bucket are also undocumented.

The doc's own scope note is stale: it says only five commands validate unknown options, but
`metrics`, `doctor`, `composer` and `fsck` all exit 2 on unknown options today.

A separate candidate finding — "define an exit-code vocabulary and standardise usage" — was run
through the pipeline and FAILED both floors (impact 0.415). The one exit-code defect in this
repo's history (`show`/`list` returning 1 instead of 2) was caught by writing the doc and a
conformance test, not by constants. That is the mitigation already in place, and this ticket
extends it rather than replacing it. Do not add a named exit-code enum.

Full generation was assessed and rejected: the command list is derivable, but per-command
*semantics* have no machine-readable source, and exit 11 is produced at the CLI layer
(`_cli/_llm_commands.py:129-171`), not in `_commands/`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Rows exist for all 75 dispatcher arms
- [ ] Codes 3, 4, 12, 75 and 78 are documented with their meanings
- [ ] The stale "only five commands validate options" note is corrected
- [ ] A CI check asserts every dispatcher arm has a row, so a new command without one fails
- [ ] The document carries a forward-compatibility sentence: an unknown non-zero code MUST be treated as failure
data.title: Make docs/exit-codes.md complete and keep it that way
